name: multi-select-checkbox-tree
title: Multi Select Checkbox Tree
description: A nested hierarchical tree component with parent indeterminate checkbox states resolving child selection.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Rail
Density: Compact
Shape: Sharp
Motion: Subtle
Typography: Monospace
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Hierarchical Checkbox Cascade: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
